name: Origin Validation Error
title: CWE-346: Origin Validation Error
ai_text: In AI software this weakness shows up almost entirely in MCP servers and the local services around them. The CVEs cover the MCP Python SDK, the MCP Ruby SDK, ash_ai, pg-aiguide, tiger-slack, genieacs-mcp, Dropbox Dash, plus Cline's dashboard server and Tencent BrowserSkill. The usual route is a browser page or extension reaching a local listener that never checks where the request came from, often through DNS rebinding or a missing origin check. Once in, an attacker can drive local tools, read project data, or control the dashboard, so a page the user simply visits can act with the trust of the local AI tooling.
description: The product does not properly verify that the source of data or communication is valid.

consequences.note: An attacker can access any functionality that is inadvertently accessible to the source.
